Hi John 

Great to chat earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the proposed next steps for the POC: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for customer-facing search + content summarization at 95th percentile latency <= 200ms and precision >= 85% on our test set.
- Initial scope: Search reranking + long-form summarization (2 use cases).
- Success criteria: latency targets (95th), accuracy thresholds on your labeled eval set, and throughput of ~500 qps during peak simulation.
- Timeline: 4-week pilot (start week of 11/29), with week 1 integration, week 2 baseline tests, week 3 iterative tuning, week 4 evaluation and review.
- Owners: Marissa (SE coordination), Camila (integration support), Acme: John (product lead), Procurement looped for SOW.

Action items I promised:
1) Share POC success criteria matrix (attached).
2) Confirm test dataset access and sandbox credentials.
3) Agree on final SOW and timeline by end of next week.

Attaching the POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx with the proposed metrics and test plan. Please comment inline or reply with changes.

Hi John 

Appreciate the feedback and totally reasonable asks. Proposed re-baseline below: 

- New scope: add Recommendation ranking as Use Case #3 (cold-start bench + warmed cache scenarios).
- Evaluation plan: A/B evaluation against Acme baseline for each use case. We'll report absolute metrics and % lift (precision@10, MRR, and summarization ROUGE-L for summaries).
- Adjusted success criteria: keep latency targets the same, accuracy target will be reported both absolute and relative.
- Timeline: start week of 12/6, 6-week pilot. Week-by-week: W1 integration + dataset handoff; W2 baseline (Acme model + Redwood baseline); W3 tuning & reranking tests; W4 recommendation cold-start scenarios; W5 load testing & stability; W6 evaluation, final report, ops handoff.
- Ownership: Marissa (commercial lead), Camila (integration & infra), Connor (sales manager  approval / SOW), John (Acme product lead).

I've updated the attached POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx with the new use case and timeline. If this looks ok I'll draft a short SOW addendum and updated timeline for procurement.
